candidates.title: OpenAI and Broadcom Unveil Custom 'Jalapeño' Inference Chip
candidates.description: OpenAI unveiled its first custom-designed ASIC chip, 'Jalapeño,' built specifically for large language model inference. Developed in a rapid nine-month cycle in partnership with Broadcom and manufactured by TSMC, early lab testing shows it delivers approximately 50% lower inference costs per token than Nvidia's Blackwell GPUs while matching their performance.
candidates.significance: First custom chip from OpenAI, built to directly challenge Nvidia's GPU monopoly and dramatically lower inference costs. This starts a new era of proprietary, vertically integrated silicon tailored specifically for advanced LLM reasoning and inference.

candidates.title: Qualcomm Acquires Modular for $3.9 Billion
candidates.description: Qualcomm announced the acquisition of Modular, the creator of the Mojo programming language and MAX platform, in a deal valued at $3.9 billion. The acquisition aims to challenge Nvidia's software moat by integrating Mojo and MAX into Qualcomm's hardware ecosystem, accelerating its expansion into the data center and enterprise AI compute market.
candidates.significance: A major consolidation targeting Nvidia's software monopoly (CUDA). Mojo and MAX are designed to compile and run AI models at native hardware speeds across diverse instruction sets, giving Qualcomm a viable software ecosystem for enterprise data centers.

candidates.title: Broadcom, Apollo, and Blackstone Launch $35 Billion AI XPV Financing Platform
candidates.description: Broadcom, Apollo Global Management, and Blackstone announced the launch of AI XPV, a massive $35 billion financing vehicle to fund next-generation AI infrastructure. The platform aims to support over 20 gigawatts of power and compute capacity through 2028, with a primary focus on supporting Anthropic's gigawatt-scale data center expansion.
candidates.significance: One of the largest private infrastructure financing deals to date, combining private equity capital with semiconductor expertise to bypass traditional cloud providers and build colossal, gigawatt-scale dedicated data centers for frontier AI development.

candidates.title: Anthropic Accuses Alibaba of Massive Claude Distillation Campaign
candidates.description: In a formal letter to U.S. Senators, Anthropic accused operators linked to Chinese e-commerce giant Alibaba of conducting a massive and highly coordinated model distillation campaign. The attack allegedly used over 25,000 fraudulent accounts to generate 28.8 million exchanges with Claude's 'Mythos Preview' model to mimic and copy its reasoning capabilities.
candidates.significance: Highlights growing geopolitical and industrial security risks surrounding frontier AI model weights and proprietary behaviors. Distillation attacks are becoming highly sophisticated, threatening the IP moats of US labs and setting up potential regulatory or policy interventions on API security.
